case_name: State of Karnataka v Papanaika and others
holding: The accused persons who are on bail, their bail bonds are cancelled and they shall surrender before the trial court to serve out the remaining sentence within one month. In case they fail to do so, the Superintendent of Police shall arrest them and send them to jail to serve out the sentence.
